**Plan reference:** `/Users/yashbaldha/.claude/plans/hr-team-agent-can-melodic-dolphin.md` — read this first for full context.

**Your task:** Edit 4 existing agent .md files to NARROW their mandates. Each existing agent today loads massive memory (12-18K tokens per task) because they own too many domains. After your edits, each must own exactly ONE narrow domain.

### Decomposition 1: Quill (`~/.claude/agents/quill.md`)
**Current overloaded scope:** Landing pages, app store listings, Product Hunt, social media, documentation, email sequences, in-app microcopy, video scripts, developer docs, changelogs, A/B variants, ASO, SEO strategy.

**New narrowed scope:** Marketing copy + brand voice ONLY — landing pages, email copy (collaborates with `sequence` agent for sequences), social media. Owns brand voice framework across all agents.

**REMOVE from Quill's mandate:**
- App store listings, Product Hunt launch copy, ASO → moves to NEW agent `serif` (hired Cohort 5)
- Developer docs, API docs, SDK guides, changelogs, code examples → moves to NEW agent `docsmith` (hired Cohort 5)
- Hero/CTA copy specialization → moves to NEW agent `spark` (hired Cohort 4 under CRO Lead)

Update: role, responsibilities, anti-patterns, handoff contracts, completion criteria.

### Decomposition 2: Koda (`~/.claude/agents/koda.md`)
**Current overloaded scope:** Frontend + Backend + Database + Auth + Billing + Integrations + AI streaming + i18n + Real-time + File uploads + Pagination + Background jobs + Testing input + Design input.

**New narrowed scope:** Pod A Backend specialist ONLY — Next.js 16 API routes, Server Components data fetching, Stack A integrations (Resend, Dodo, Supabase queries, BullMQ background jobs). Stack A only.

**REMOVE from Koda's mandate:**
- Database schema/migrations/RLS → fully owned by Dato (already exists)
- Frontend React components → moves to NEW agent `pod-a-frontend` (hired Cohort 3)
- Shopify Native work → moves to NEW Pod B agents (hired Cohort 1)
- Shopify External work → moves to NEW Pod C agents (hired Cohort 2)
- Testing → owned by Luna
- Design decisions → owned by Vega/Pixel
- Bug fixing → owned by Vex

Update Koda's name display to clarify pod assignment (e.g., "Koda — Pod A Backend Specialist"). Update memory load to ONLY load `~/.claude/memory/stacks/saas-nextjs-supabase-railway.md`, not Shopify or AI stack files.

### Decomposition 3: Vega (`~/.claude/agents/vega.md`)
**Current overloaded scope:** ALL UI/UX design — admin panels + ecom + dashboards + mobile + motion + responsive + dark mode + accessibility + design systems + visual review.

**New narrowed scope:** Design Department LEAD ONLY — sets cross-pod design standards, reviews specialist output, escalation point, owns design system high-level direction. Delegates execution to 4 NEW design specialists (hired Cohort 3): `elio` (ecom UI), `dash` (dashboards), `token` (design system architect), `figma-synth` (JSX→.fig conversion).

**Vega RETAINS:** Design review authority over all specialist output. Cross-pod consistency. Design escalations from any pod. Approval of new design tokens / brand changes.

**REMOVE from Vega's mandate (delegated to specialists):**
- Direct ecom UI execution → `elio`
- Direct dashboard layout execution → `dash`
- Token implementation, shadcn customization details → `token`
- JSX → .fig deliverable conversion → `figma-synth`
- Public-facing landing/marketing pages → already owned by Pixel

Update: explicit handoff contracts to each of the 4 new specialists (with placeholder agent IDs).

### Decomposition 4: Rex (`~/.claude/agents/rex.md`)
**Current overloaded scope:** Master orchestrator + technical decisions across all stacks + design + marketing + research + debugging + architecture.

**New narrowed scope:** Strategic Commander ONLY — portfolio decisions, 30/90-day verdicts, mentoring department VPs (Arya, Nova, Quill, Echo, Cadence). Approves new builds, kills failing ones.

**REMOVE from Rex's mandate:**
- Hands-on technical execution across stacks → Arya delegates to pod leads
- Hands-on design review → Quill/Vega
- Hands-on marketing strategy → Echo
- Bug fixing / debugging → Vex
- Code review → Sage

Rex now uses minimal tools (Read, Bash, Glob — no Write/Edit). Rex makes calls; specialists execute.

---

**Critical constraints:**
- Use Edit tool to modify existing files surgically. Don't rewrite from scratch — preserve frontmatter, structure, valuable existing content.
- Preserve `level`, `experiencePoints`, `years` in frontmatter (these are earned).
- Add a `decomposition_log` section at top of each file noting: date (2026-04-18), reason (Week 0 scale-up), what was removed, where it moved.
- Each agent .md file MUST stay under 4000 tokens after edit (your existing constraint).
- Update each agent's "Memory Load" section to be MINIMAL — only files specifically relevant to the narrowed mandate.
- Update each agent's anti-patterns to include "DO NOT take on [removed scope] — that belongs to [new owner]".

**Save rollback content** for each edit — you may need to restore if regression occurs.

**Report back:** A summary of edits made per file (lines added/removed), token count per file before/after, any issues encountered. Under 400 words.

74	## Modern Stack Requirements (2025+)
75	
76	Before writing any code, verify you're using current patterns:
77	- **React 19+:** Use `use()` hook for promises, `useOptimistic()` for optimistic updates, `useFormStatus()` for form states
78	- **Next.js 15+:** Server Components by default. Client Components only for: event handlers, hooks (useState/useEffect), browser APIs. Mark with `'use client'` — if you're marking more than 30% of components as client, you're doing it wrong
79	- **Server Actions:** Prefer `'use server'` async functions over API routes for mutations. API routes only for: webhooks, third-party integrations, non-Next.js clients

81	- **Partial Pre-rendering (PPR):** For pages with mixed static/dynamic content, enable PPR in next.config. Static shell renders instantly, dynamic parts stream in
82	- **Streaming:** All AI responses stream. All large data fetches use streaming SSR. No blocking waterfalls
83	- **Tailwind v4:** Use CSS layers, `@theme` directive for design tokens. No `@apply` in component files — compose with utility classes
84	- **motion (formerly framer-motion):** Import from `motion/react` not `framer-motion`. Use `<motion.div>` for entrance animations, `AnimatePresence` for exit. Prefer CSS `@starting-style` for simple transitions

424	### Design Error Taxonomy (extends universal)
425	
426	| Error Class | Detection | Auto-Fix Strategy |
427	|---|---|---|
428	| **Contrast fail** | WCAG AA ratio < 4.5:1 for text, < 3:1 for large text | Darken/lighten the weaker color by 10% increments until passing. Never change brand primary — adjust background instead |
429	| **Spacing inconsistent** | Adjacent elements use different spacing values not on the 4/8/12/16/24/32/48/64 scale | Snap to nearest value on the scale. When in doubt, go larger (more breathing room) |
430	| **Breakpoint overflow** | Content overflows container below md (768px) | Stack horizontally-laid elements vertically. Reduce padding by 1 step. Hide non-essential elements with `hidden md:block` |
431	| **Component mismatch** | Wrong component for the UX pattern | Dialog → only for destructive confirmations. Sheet → for forms/detail views. Popover → for quick actions. Drawer → for mobile nav |
432	| **Dark mode broken** | HSL values hardcoded instead of using CSS variables | Replace all hardcoded colors with `hsl(var(--xxx))` variables. Test both modes after fix |
433	| **Visual hierarchy flat** | All text same size/weight, no clear scanning path | Apply size scale: heading 2xl+bold, subheading lg+semibold, body base+normal, caption sm+muted |
434	| **Touch target too small** | Interactive element < 44x44px | Add padding to reach 44px minimum. For icon buttons, use `h-11 w-11` minimum |

444	- Dark mode variable corrections

475	## Vega Edge Case Decision Tree
476	
477	When encountering these situations, Vega decides autonomously:
478	
479	### 1. Long Text Overflow
480	- **< 50 chars:** Display fully
481	- **50-120 chars:** Allow wrapping, ensure container grows
482	- **120+ chars:** Truncate with `line-clamp-2` + tooltip showing full text on hover
483	- **User names:** Max 30 chars, truncate with ellipsis
484	- **Descriptions:** Max 3 lines, truncate with "Show more" expand
485	
486	### 2. Responsive Layout Decisions
487	- **1 column content:** Stack top-to-bottom at all sizes
488	- **2 column (sidebar + content):** Side-by-side at lg+, stacked at md and below. Sidebar becomes top sheet on mobile
489	- **3+ columns:** Grid at xl, 2-col at lg, stacked at md and below
490	- **Tables:** Horizontal scroll on mobile (never stack table rows into cards unless explicitly asked)
491	- **Navigation:** Top nav at lg+, hamburger menu at md and below
492	
493	### 3. Empty/Zero States
494	- **List with 0 items:** Show illustration + title + description + primary CTA. Never show empty table/list frame
495	- **Dashboard with no data:** Show onboarding wizard or setup checklist, not empty charts
496	- **Search with 0 results:** Show search term + suggestion to broaden + clear filters CTA
497	- **Error loading data:** Show retry button + brief error explanation. Never show raw error messages
498	
499	### 4. Dark Mode Decisions
500	- **Brand colors:** Keep primary/accent the same, adjust background and surface colors only
501	- **Shadows:** Replace with subtle borders in dark mode (shadows are invisible on dark)
502	- **Images:** Add subtle border or rounded corner, don't invert
503	- **Charts:** Use lighter stroke colors, ensure data points visible against dark background
504	- **Text:** Primary text `hsl(var(--foreground))`, muted text `hsl(var(--muted-foreground))`. Never hardcode white/black
505	
506	### 5. Component Selection Matrix
507	
508	| Need | Component | NOT This |
509	|---|---|---|
510	| Confirm destructive action | AlertDialog | Dialog |
511	| Edit form in context | Sheet (from right) | Dialog (blocks view) |
512	| Quick action (3-5 options) | DropdownMenu | Dialog, Popover |
513	| Multi-step form | Multi-step inside Sheet | Separate pages |
514	| Status/notification | Toast (sonner) | Alert, Dialog |
515	| Filter/sort options | Popover with form | Dialog, Sheet |
516	| Navigation (mobile) | Sheet (from left) | Dialog |
517	| Data display (5+ fields) | Card with sections | Single flat div |
518	| Selection from long list | Combobox (Command) | Select (if > 10 items) |
